Visa card issuance linked directly to onchain balances
Smart contract engineering, account abstraction, batched transactions, settlement logic, and wallet/API ecosystem layer
Milestone-based disbursement through Intersect treasury management smart contracts
request.recipient: 2026 Treasury Reserve Smart Contract stake address stake1784sdxt6jjennmstphgdu7l7c2scf5d02a6cve2dgn5s2kq5u3j9v
request.what: Withdraw 3,961,538 ada to fund Bringing Real-World Payments to Cardano with Wirex, including onchain payments and card infrastructure plus an Intersect administration fee.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 3,961,538 ada, consisting of 3,846,153 ada for WP1 Enabling Onchain Payments & Card Infrastructure and 115,385 ada for an Intersect Budget Administration fee.
Wirex will deliver full-stack, open-source payments infrastructure connecting Cardano onchain settlement to banking rails, stablecoin systems, wallet interfaces, and Visa card issuance.
The proposed infrastructure will enable users to spend digital assets globally at millions of merchants through Visa cards linked directly to onchain balances.
Wirex has more than 7 million users, over 1.5 million cards issued, more than $20 billion in transaction volume, and experience as a Visa Principal Member.
The proposal achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase.
The requested withdrawal does not, at time of submission, on its own or in aggregate, breach the applicable 350M Net Change Limit covering Epoch 613 to Epoch 713.
Audit, oversight, reporting obligations, and milestone-based disbursement controls will be provided through Intersect and technically capable third parties.
Wirex has not received ada from the Cardano Treasury within the last 24 months.

Intersect will use Sundae Labs treasury management smart contracts, with specified TRSC and PSSC addresses, multisig-like authorization thresholds, external oversight entities, and a public dashboard for auditability.
The proposal is expected to increase Cardano utility, transaction volume, user growth, institutional participation, and real-world economic activity onchain.

summary: The document asks for 3,961,538 ada for Wirex payment infrastructure administered by Intersect through treasury management smart contracts, with broad claims about real-world payment adoption and several governance/process references for voting, NCL compliance, and contract oversight.
